decision.reason: The workbook write is correctly targeted, but its materialization result is not propagated to the caller. e55099eb5_25 constructs the save result and final report, yet root scope e55099eb5_11 has no outputs and publicOutputs is empty. Export the actual materialization result and completion report from the root; computing them internally or writing the workbook does not satisfy the required output propagation.
